verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Navan publishes a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at developer.navan.com. The docs show it indexes both the Expense API and the MCP server, mirrors the full markdown guide, and gives agent-oriented guidance such as setup configs, auth model, and lean-payload tips. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec for the API surface, and independent hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
